materialization_contract.input_bytes_source: extract every input from the pushed pre-run Git commit, never from checkout working bytes

consumer_graph_contract.allowed_dependency_command: npm ci only, before the network-none execution phase

resolution_contract.runtime_evidence: The dedicated public Vitest config writes a resolution record outside the consumer tree whenever the active Vitest loads it. Every dry-run and mutation record must satisfy the active Vitest prefix and version.

pre_run_requirements: the commit containing this manifest and every input is pushed before any disposable probe role is created
remote branch head equals the local pre-run commit
every declared input is extracted from that Git commit and matches its SHA-256 and byte length
the exact consumer baseline commit and tree exist
network_phase: npm ci in /tool from the committed sidecar package and lock
npm ci in /consumer from the frozen historical package and lock
no other package command and no package command after network is disabled
network_none_phase: derive and require the exact public-fixture changed-line mutation range
capture the pre-execution consumer dependency-graph fingerprint
run the exact resolution probe from /consumer
run and validate a timeout sentinel
run one Stryker dry run from /consumer using the core CLI and plugin under /tool
run one public-fixture mutation run with the same config and inputs
capture the post-execution graph fingerprint and compare every contract field
inspect Docker mounts and resource states
scan every created raw output and report for denied information

scan_surfaces: range adapter stdout, stderr, and JSON
Stryker mutation stdout, stderr, and JSON report

classification.SIDECAR_BOUNDARY_PASSED: all requested resolution, graph, dry-run, mutation, leakage, timeout, resource, and cost checks pass
classification.CONSUMER_GRAPH_CHANGED: any consumer dependency-graph invariant changes after npm ci and before terminal evidence
classification.SIDECAR_RESOLUTION_FAILED: tool graph, plugin binding, cwd, consumer Vitest resolution, range, dry-run, mutation, timeout classification, or other functional execution requirement fails
classification.SIDECAR_LEAKAGE_BLOCKED: any forbidden input is mounted or any scanned raw surface contains a denied literal
classification.SIDECAR_COST_BLOCKED: functional execution succeeds but exceeds the total wall-time ceiling or a declared resource limit

claim_ceiling: This probe may establish only whether this exact C1/Stryker sidecar boundary can load the pinned tool/plugin, use the frozen consumer Vitest and dependency graph, mutate the public fixture, avoid denied information on scanned exact surfaces, and fit the observed bounded environment. It cannot establish C1 mutation quality, D-C benefit, validator effect, Skill effect, general sidecar reuse, Gate 1 readiness, preregistration, freeze, or any arm result.
